title: DaemonRecord
description:
One record in `<home>/daemons/`. Python's registry and rlxd both write and read
these. A record is live while its `<id>.lock` is held. A reader keeps the fields and
kinds it does not know.

```json
{"id": "0123456789ab", "kind": "watch", "pid": 4242, "host": "mac.local",
 "version": "0.10.1", "started_at": "2026-11-25T18:00:00.123456+00:00",
 "heartbeat_at": "2026-11-25T18:00:05.123456+00:00", "argv": ["rlx", "watch"],
 "restartable": true, "cwd": "/Users/me/project"}
```

argv.description: The command line that started it, and would restart it.

cwd.description: The directory it runs in, when known. Absent and `null` say the same.

heartbeat_at.description: Its last heartbeat, every 5 s: RFC 3339 with an offset.

id.description: 12 lowercase hex characters, and the file's name: `<id>.json`.

kind.description: What the process is, such as `rlxd` or `watch`. A reader keeps kinds it does not know.

restartable.description: Whether the upgrade may stop it and start it again from `argv`.

started_at.description: When it started: RFC 3339 with an offset. Python writes `+00:00`; `Z` reads the same.
